cohort: The study participants were 293 singleton pregnant women aged over 45 years, with an intended vaginal delivery, managed at five Italian academic maternity centers between 2016 and 2022.
finding: A predictive model was developed that estimates the probability of vaginal delivery based on maternal age, pregestational BMI, height, parity, and whether labor was induced.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery occurred in 75.8% of cases, with 24.2% undergoing Cesarean section and 17.6% of vaginal deliveries involving vacuum assistance.
